title: Accommodation Supplement: eligibility under the Social Security Act 1964 formula (s 61EA), OpenFisca Aotearoa encoding, week 2018-W01 (supplementary table)

attributes.name: age
attributes.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:80-89 (age at period.first_day >= parameters/social_security/accommodation_supplement/age_threshold.yaml, value 16 from 1964-12-04; reference SSA 1964 DLM359124)

attributes.name: immigration__resident
attributes.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:107; openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/immigration/residence.py:34-42 (ETERNITY; formula holds_resident_visa + permanent_resident; set directly by the official tests, see CONVERSION.md 2)

attributes.name: social_security__ordinarily_resident_in_new_zealand
attributes.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:101-104 (SSA 1964 s 74AA; read at period.first_month); resident.py:77 (input variable, ETERNITY)

attributes.name: accommodation_supplement__accommodation_costs
attributes.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:112-115; costs.py:11 (default False; its only formula starts 2018-11-26, so before that date it is an input)

attributes.name: social_housing__eligible
attributes.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:117-118 (has social housing; entitlement needs False); entitled.py:142 (input variable, default True)

exclusions.description: Holder of a permanent resident visa who is not 'Holder of a permanent resident visa or a resident visa'. The encoding defines immigration__resident as that disjunction.

period.why: The week asserted by all 6 cases of 1964/entitled.yaml. formula_1964_12_04 applies until 2018-11-25; the one parameter (age threshold 16) has a single value since 1964-12-04.

household.why: The 1964 formula reads only person-level variables.

date_of_birth.value: not set; age is set directly for every day of the week
date_of_birth.why: The official tests set age directly.

notes: Supplementary table, kept outside paperC/specs so that it is not counted as a sample. It is the earlier formula version of the same variable as NZ-AS; all 6 official SSA 1964 entitlement cases map onto it.
